## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Breaking change (`feat!:` / `BREAKING CHANGE:`)
- [ ] Documentation / chore

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `terraform fmt -recursive` is clean
- [ ] `terraform test` passes, and new behaviour is covered by a `run` block
- [ ] `terraform-docs .` has been run if inputs or outputs changed
- [ ] Examples still validate and were updated if the interface changed
